partnerships.intro: Xiluet Smiles works with general dentists, specialists, clinics abroad, and travel and hospitality businesses in Miami. If your patients or clients could use a smile design, porcelain veneers, full mouth reconstruction or All-on-X, tell us about your practice or business and a doctor will follow up.
partnerships.formTitle: Tell us about your practice or business
partnerships.formIntro: A short message is enough. We reply within a few hours during office hours, in English or Spanish.
partnerships.messagePlaceholder: Who you are, where you are based, and how you would like to work together.

points.d: Refer cosmetic and full-arch cases to a team with an in-house lab; your patient returns to you for ongoing care.

Hotels, concierges and medical travel agencies: our coordinator handles dates and sends hotel and ride guidance to every out-of-state patient.
